eligible_session_rule: first XNYS session whose session_date is strictly after the acceptanceDateTime calendar date
arrival_density_definition: count of accepted filings whose eligible_session lies in the current decision session and the preceding 19 completed XNYS sessions
lineage_rule: retain every accession separately; amendments are not collapsed
security_mapping: frozen Q107 issuer ticker to current SEC CIK lookup; no performance-era asset selection
output: per-session arrival count over fixed 20-session window
mutation_tests: future acceptance cannot alter any earlier compiled state
chronological acceptance ordering is invariant to input row order
